optimizer.action_change_rule: one of exactly A0..A9 per 160 layer/head cells; no iterative parameter mutation
optimizer.ordering: sampled layer ascending, then head ascending, then A0,A1,A2,A3,A4,A5,A6,A7,A8,A9
optimizer.tie_breaking: relative-L2 ascending, cosine descending, traffic ascending, lexical action table ascending
